visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Later rule does not apply
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The button should turn red, but it stays blue. A second rule comes later in the file, yet an id rule above is more specific and keeps winning.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
<style>
  #go { background: blue; color: white; }
  .danger { background: red; }
</style>
<button id="go" class="danger">Delete</button>

solution.code:
<style>
  button { background: blue; color: white; }
  .danger { background: red; }
</style>
<button id="go" class="danger">Delete</button>
solution.explanation: The selector #go has more weight than .danger, so it wins even though it comes first. Keep selectors short and similar in weight, so the later rule can win without needing a stronger selector.
